turns.assessment: The failure is isolated to svc005: other services on the same S15–S05 lightpath, including svc139 with identical endpoints, remain healthy, and all line, channel, and amplifier measurements show no change. The simultaneous CLIENT_SF alarms are therefore downstream consequences of a service-specific failure, while EQPT_PORT_FAIL directly identifies the svc005 client port at S15.

proposals.rationale: A critical EQPT_PORT_FAIL was raised at this exact port at onset. A client-port failure explains interruption of only svc005 and the CLIENT_SF alarms at both ends, while leaving the shared optical lightpath and other services unaffected.
The S05 client port also raised CLIENT_SF, but it did not raise EQPT_PORT_FAIL; this is much more likely a remote consequence of the S15 failure.
